services.desc: The China Lake Museum is not just a collection of artifacts. It is the story of a place where scientists, engineers, military personnel, and civilians worked together to solve problems, developing the weapons and systems needed by our military. Our exhibits bring that story to life through the largest collection of tactical air-launched weapons and related exhibits. Together, they show how China Lake became the center of excellence for air-launched weapons and grew into one of the nation’s leading research, development, test, and evaluation centers. blurb: The Naval Ordnance Test Station (NOTS) was established on 8 November, 1943 near Inyokern California. Air launched rockets built by the California Institute of Technology (Caltech), based on British technology, were tested here.
